main.description: Migrates a source record into a fresh community, cloning its structure and importing its members. The 'kind' discriminator selects the migration; today only legacy communities are supported, but the endpoint is designed to host future migrations. Provisioning mirrors community.create (managed when no PDS credentials are supplied, bring-your-own otherwise).

kind.description: The migration to run. 'legacy-community' migrates a pre-rework community record.

source.description: The record being migrated (e.g. the legacy community).

input.description: Optional replacement community picture blob, as a `picture` part. Migrated communities have no banner.

channelMap.description: Maps each cloned channel from its old AT-URI to its new AT-URI.

channelMapping.description: A single channel's old AT-URI mapped to its new AT-URI.
